# R&G Collections (Atelier & Bespoke Menswear)

> Contemporary luxury menswear, handcrafted leather footwear, bespoke Senator suits, and master-crafted Nigerian ceremonial native wear. Defined by style, designed for you.

R&G Collections is a Nigerian luxury fashion atelier specializing in modern tailoring, ceremonial bespoke garments (Senator suits, Kaftans, Agbadas), handcrafted Italian calfskin footwear, and minimalist luxury streetwear.

For complete brand specifications, sizing guides, tailoring processes, and policies, see [Full LLM Knowledge Document](https://r-g-three.vercel.app/llms-full.txt).

## Brand Identity & Overview
- **Brand Name**: R&G Collections (also known as R&G, R&G Atelier, R & G Fashion House)
- **Tagline**: Fashion That Moves With You | Defined by style. Designed for you.
- **Website**: https://r-g-three.vercel.app
- **Industry**: Luxury Menswear, Bespoke Tailoring, Premium Footwear & High Fashion
- **HQ & Service Hubs**: Lagos and Akure / Owo (Achievers University), Nigeria
- **Shipping Coverage**: Express same-day courier in Lagos and Akure; 1-3 business days nationwide across Nigeria; worldwide international shipping available upon request.
- **Accepted Currencies**: Nigerian Naira (NGN), US Dollar (USD), British Pound (GBP), Euro (EUR)
- **Payment Methods**: Paystack, Debit/Credit Cards, Direct Bank Transfer

## Core Garment Collections
- [Shop All Menswear](https://r-g-three.vercel.app/shop): Browse all available ready-to-wear garments, seasonal capsules, and footwear.
- [Curated Lookbooks & Archives](https://r-g-three.vercel.app/collections): High-fashion styling editorial showcasing bespoke tailoring, ceremonial native ensembles, and footwear.
- **Ceremonial & Native Menswear**:
  - Master-crafted Senator suits with imperial gold and obsidian accents.
  - Bespoke embroidered Agbadas, regal Kaftans, and traditional groom ensembles.
- **Contemporary Luxury Essentials**:
  - Heavyweight monochromatic oversized hoodies (450 GSM French Terry).
  - Minimalist tailored trousers, luxury linen resort shirts, and evening knitwear.
- **Handcrafted Footwear & Leather Goods**:
  - Hand-welted Chelsea boots, double monk straps, and penny loafers crafted from premium Italian calfskin.
  - Architectural minimalist leather sneakers.
